description: A React component implementing a multi-step wizard form for creating a test, utilizing react-hook-form for form state management, zod for validation, and calling an API endpoint to create the test.

methods.name: TestWizard
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a two-step wizard to create a test, managing form state, validation, and API interaction.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the wizard to the next step, maximum step is 2.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step, minimum is 1.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls the create API method, shows notification, and triggers onCreated callback.
